intro: Dated notes on what changed in the index: providers added, rows pruned, corrections and audits. Newest first.

items.title: Nine providers from non-English sweeps, including a 365M-token yearly quota
items.summary: Searching in Chinese, Russian, Japanese and German surfaced GigaChat's 365M tokens a year, plus AxForge, DeepSeek, GonkaRouter, Vectoree, NLP Cloud, Liquid AI, Qiniu and BlockRun.
details: GigaChat is the largest published allowance on the index: 365M tokens a year for individuals, renewed annually.
AxForge renews 3M tokens every 30 days, the only recurring EU allowance found.
BlockRun leaves nine open-weight models free with no key, account or wallet.
The allowance board now understands yearly periods and ranks them on a 30-day equivalent.
Eight leads rejected and two confirmed dead, including ACLIDE's shutdown.

items.title: Sibling domains get their own entries
items.summary: Clean APIs, Radox AI and Oxion AI run one catalogue but each signup carries its own 500K-token monthly allowance, so all three are catalogued instead of being folded into one card.
details: Separate signup means separate allowance: three accounts now show as three 500K/month lines on the allowance board.
FreeModel keeps its larger 1M/month allowance on its own card.
codecraftapi.com runs the same product with no free tier and stays out.
SCHEMA.md now records the rule.

items.title: Ten leads added from account-level checks; five new domains triaged
items.summary: TokenReply, Coarena and ValorGPT free model lists arrived from logged-in catalogues and are now rows. FreeModel and Clean APIs were checked from a direct report and publish 1M and 0.5M monthly free allowances.
details: TokenReply: 22 free-tagged IDs, 40 requests/day to Models of the week, daily reward.
Coarena: 3 free models, 30 rpm, 2 concurrent
ValorGPT: 15 free text models of 523, image model excluded.
FreeModel and Clean APIs publish monthly token allowances with no card
radoxai and oxionai are the same product and are covered by the Clean APIs card.
codecraftapi.com is the same product without any free tier — rejected.

items.title: Five leads verified and added; Subaxis confirmed dead
items.summary: Nexusify, UnoRouter, onomeo, StudioLM and DGrid passed first-party checks. TokenReply, Coarena and ValorGPT are held because their free model lists only render inside an account.
details: Nexusify renews $25 of credit every Monday with no card, 130 rpm, across 99 text models.
UnoRouter marks 159 of its 294 routes free with a :free suffix on one key.
onomeo gives free models a per-window call quota
StudioLM's chat route has a free daily allowance
DGrid publishes a $0/M router model.
Subaxis is closed — its homepage is a shutdown notice. CoderPlan, A4F and pool'edAI publish no free tier.
data/LEAD_VERIFICATION.md records the verdict for every lead.

items.title: An Updates page, and the Pollinations catalogue rebuilt
items.summary: FreeToken now keeps a dated changelog in data/announcements.json, rendered at #/updates. This entry also rewrites Pollinations against its live catalogue and adds Electron Hub and AnyAPI.
details: Pollinations: the four 2024-era rows (Qwen3 4B, Gemma 3 4B, Mistral Small 3.2, GPT-OSS 20B) were replaced with the current catalogue — six vendor models on Quest pollen and six zero-Pollen community or stealth models.
Electron Hub: Free plan, 24 models behind a `:free` suffix, 200 free-model requests a day at 5 requests a minute, no card.
AnyAPI: Free plan, 100K ANY tokens a day, 400+ models behind one key, no card.
New `tools/add_announcement.py` prepends a dated entry and validates the file, so future passes land in the same place.

items.title: xKiro and cheapllm.shop added; nine non-text rows pruned
items.summary: xKiro keeps 26 of its 69 models at zero price with 500K tokens a day, doubled after Telegram verification. cheapllm.shop publishes a permanent hourly free floor.
details: xKiro: all Cohere models, eight Mistral models including Large 3/Medium 3.5/Codestral, SenseNova 6.8 Flash-Lite and one stealth model are free.
cheapllm.shop: 5K input + 1K output tokens per hour forever, no card, one model.
Whisper and embedding rows removed from Groq, Cloudflare, OVHcloud, Scaleway, Replicate and OCI — the index is text-LLM only.
Groq's allowance figure moved from 1.2M to 1.0M tokens/day as a result.

items.title: Every provider on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard given a verdict
items.summary: 40 providers read from the AA price/performance leaderboard and tested against the free-access rule; data/AA_PROVIDERS_AUDIT.md records each one.
details: 19 were already catalogued, 1 was added from the same list (GMI Cloud), the rest are GPU clouds, per-token hosts or model owners with no free API.
Together AI is the one disputed case: third-party posts claim signup credits and free models, its own pricing page lists per-token rates only.

items.title: All 128 ledger records re-verified, twelve providers added
items.summary: The July research ledger was checked record by record; data/LEDGER_AUDIT.md carries a verdict for every row.
details: Covered 44 · added 13 · rejected 63 · dead 4 · proxy 3 · out of scope 1.
Rejected rows included GitHub Models (retired 2026-07-30), kluster.ai (sunset 2026-06-09), Chutes (paid-only) and Infini-AI (no trial quota).

items.title: Period-aware allowance ranking and three providers from the ledger
items.summary: Ranks now compare a 30-day equivalent, so a daily cap is not beaten by a smaller monthly one. NaraRouter, PLaMo and ApiFreeLLM joined.
details: 7M tokens/day outranks 30M/month once both are expressed per 30 days.
Rows still show the period the provider actually publishes.

items.title: Five more providers from an independent catalogue sweep
items.summary: A sweep of free-inference directories and community lists added providers the earlier sources had missed.
details: One correction came out of it: an 'inferall' free tier that does not exist was removed rather than kept.

items.title: Unpublished allowances are no longer invented
items.summary: Where a provider does not publish a token allowance, the card and the leaderboards now say so instead of showing an estimate.
details: Catalogue size is reported separately from the number of models the index lists.
Requirement-only offers stop borrowing a model row.

items.title: Text-LLM scope enforced, navbar search wired
items.summary: Hosted text-LLM providers only, a working navbar search and a provider-level allowance board.
details: Cerebras left the index when its no-card free tier ended in August 2026.
Self-hosted runtimes stay out of scope.

items.title: Standalone provider pages and Artificial Analysis scores
items.summary: Each provider got its own URL, with AA v5.0.1 intelligence and curated throughput shown per model.
details: Detail routes look like #/providers/<id>.
Full leaderboard pages replaced the dashboard-only charts.

items.title: Catalogue rebuilt around hosted providers
items.summary: The first shape of FreeToken: a JSON catalogue of hosted free LLM APIs with a static browser over it.
details: Self-hosted entries were removed and the data moved to one file per provider.
